name: Extra Elective
body:
You gain an additional elective.

Prerequisite(s): Electives class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional elective. You must meet the requirements to select this elective.

Special: This feat can be selected more than once. Each time it is selected, you gain one more elective.
